digest.component_or_area: JiraConfig validation and URL scheme enforcement
propositions: JiraConfig silently accepts non-https jira.url without validation, risking credential exposure in cleartext
Three load_config().jira consumers swallow ConfigError, preventing validation from reaching config consumers in write_jira_config and resolve paths
Parity gap: DC's ReconcilerConfig rejects non-https via _validate_reconciler_tls in __post_init__, but Cloud's JiraConfig has no validation
write_jira_config persists jira.url without scheme validation, allowing onboarding wizard to silently write cleartext urls
Validation must be fail-loud in resolve_jira_settings (before env fallback) and write_jira_config (before persist), while _jira_onboard._detect remains best-effort to keep recovery wizard usable
